first.rationale: Prioritize verification of the directly relevant onboarding result and the consequential pricing alternative. Current declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the strongest root-cause experiment for durable qualified revenue, while pricing remains a competing response to SMB pressure that requires validation before use.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and demonstrated higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (-2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than merely acquisition. The pricing alternative is ruled out for this objective because its verified retention decline makes its qualified-revenue lift unsustainable. Activation messaging remains plausible, but its inherited evidence is less directly tied to the observed onboarding deterioration.
